passageExcerpt: 6.1 Clinical accuracy (SpO2). A controlled desaturation study per ISO 80601-2-61:2017 clause 201.12.1.101 was conducted

response.evidence_snippet: A controlled desaturation study per ISO 80601-2-61:2017 clause 201.12.1.101 was conducted at the University of California San Francisco Hypoxia Laboratory in 12 healthy adult volunteers, yielding 216 paired data points against a Radiometer ABL90 CO-oximeter over the saturation range 70 to 100 %. ... Result: SpO2 accuracy root mean square (ARMS) 1.9 % over 70–100 %.
